text: ok and then how do i for example use both paintings, or more. exporting i assume overwrites it if i go and load one painting and export then come back and do the other painting and export again
resolution: Built paint skins as placeables (V24: variety lives in the CATALOG — a stored painting is a SKIN on the exported prop). Every saved paint variant now persists its own paint-space mesh blob (paints/paint_<id>.blob) beside its png — written on Save/Update and self-healed the first time you Load an older variant; the build palette's Props tray expands each exported model into one tile per stored painting (label: 'model · painting name'); arming that tile ghosts and places THAT painting, and the skinned id (prop:<modelId>#p<id>) rides the placed piece so saved worlds keep each placement's skin. Multiple paintings of the same model place side by side — exporting no longer overwrites the one look. Answering the verbatim concern: yes, before this the export carried only the last-saved painting; now each painting is its own placeable. To activate for the existing bridge_foot paintings: open the model, Load each painting once (heals the blob), then the Props tray shows both entries.
